reviewNotes: Held back: the score has bars of another length (bar 10, 13), which the solfa grid does not draw. Imported from CCEH tune 000230 (the melody read from 000230a.mid, checked against the page's do-re-mi incipit, 2 notes off in 16); check the notes and the bar lines against a hymn book you trust, then set "reviewed": true. Alexander Galloway has no death year on CCEH's page or ours; the tune was in print by 1562, before 1850, so they died before 1955 (they would have been over 105). The bar lines are those of CCEH's Noteworthy score (000230a.nwc).
